text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, the final race of the 
Classics. The victor was Cheval Grand,
who 
pushed past all her limits and ran with 
everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race,
Kitasan Black runs over to 
Cheval Grand. Amidst the cheers, she 
expresses both her frustration and her 
refreshing congratulations after giving
it their all in the showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from giving her all in
the 
Kikuka Sho, Cheval Grand opens up about 
what's in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black was similar to herself;
she had never stood out and had harbored 
feelings of inferiority,
yet she faced her 
weaknesses and overcame them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—She wanted to believe that she, too, 
possessed a strength unique to her own 
self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand began looking beyond her 
immediate surroundings.
Setting her sights 
on future showdowns with Kitasan Black, 
she resolved to devote herself to 
training.
